iv2025-cluj-forzaeth-wins.alt: Poster for the 25th RoboRacer Autonomous Racing Competition, June 22 to 25, 2025, at IEEE IV 2025 in Cluj-Napoca: the RoboRacer wordmark over a city street with light trails.

cdc2024-milan-scuderia-segfault-wins.alt: Poster for the 22nd competition, December 16 to 19, 2024, at IEEE CDC 2024 in Milan.

bu2024-lehigh-wins.alt: Poster for the 23rd competition, November 22, 2024, at the Learning to Trust Autonomy Workshop at Boston University.

f1tenth-korea-delegation-upenn.alt: Poster for the 15th RoboRacer Autonomous Racing Competition, May 13 to 17, 2024, at ICRA 2024 in Yokohama, Japan: a race car drifting through smoke.

roboracer-rules-repository-2025.alt: Poster for the 26th RoboRacer Autonomous Racing Competition, December 22 to 24, 2025, at Techfest IIT Bombay in Mumbai: an orange race car numbered 31 on a blurred street under the RoboRacer wordmark.

f1tenth-to-roboracer-announced.alt: An 'Under construction' banner: a city skyline with cranes above yellow and black hazard stripes and the address www.RoboRacer.ai.

iros2024-abudhabi-dzik-ultimate-wins.alt: Two rows of competitors and organizers pose behind a line of cars and trophies at the edge of the track in the exhibition hall at IROS 2024 in Abu Dhabi.

icra2024-yokohama-vaul-wins.alt: Lukasz Sztyber gives a thumbs-up beside his car and an F1TENTH banner at ICRA 2024 in Yokohama.

course2024-three-university-race.alt: Students line a track of yellow ducting on a paved plaza on 33rd Street as a car races past, at the Penn, CMU and Lehigh race on April 29, 2024.

iros2020-virtual-hipert-wins.alt: The final rounds of the head-to-head bracket of the virtual eighth F1TENTH Grand Prix at IROS 2020, from round 3 to the final between HiPeRT Modena and C.A.T.

f1tenth-foundation-2020.alt: Top view of the 1/10-scale F1/10 car, the image on the f1tenth.org homepage in May 2020.

medium-adventures-in-autonomous-vehicles.alt: A car runs between white tube barriers on a polished floor during track testing at Penn's Levine Hall, December 4, 2018.

nsf-community-platform-award-2019.alt: A car drives between white tube barriers and cardboard boxes on a stone floor at the Penn course's final race, December 10, 2018.

daily-pennsylvanian-2018-dining-hall.alt: A car with green wheels drives down a corridor past an AprilTag marker at Penn's mid-semester race, November 6, 2018.
